name: companion-ball
description: 桌面陪伴 · 团子猫：常驻桌角的 AI 团子猫，可聊天、可拖拽

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:legal && electron-vite build
scripts.clean: rimraf out out-release out-release-key out-public release dist
scripts.build:key: node scripts/build-bundled-key.js && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.key.yml
scripts.build:personal: npm run build:legal && node scripts/build-bundled-key.js && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.key.yml
scripts.build:personal:mac: npm run build:legal && node scripts/build-bundled-key.js && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.key.yml
scripts.build:public: npm run build:legal && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.public.yml
scripts.build:public:mac: npm run build:legal && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.public.yml
